messages:
maria: Quick Q — when the automatic fallback fires, do we want a single ‘cause’ badge in the console that tries to classify quota vs model-error vs infra/latency? I sketched a thing that shows: reason + confidence + link to evidence. Thoughts?

alex: I like a small badge but pls no overconfident labels. show ‘probable cause’ with a confidence meter and then let users expand into raw signals.

jen: Expandable evidence panel sounds right. minimal list: error-rate spikes, 5xx types, token-limit hits, queue-depth, regional failovers, rollout stage. each item should link to the telemetry slice.

kevin: From compliance POV we need the full decision chain in an auditable event. propose an event `fallback_decision` that records inputs so we can deterministically replay why it picked fallback X. include model_version, route_snapshot, operator overrides.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled fallback-policy v0.9 to staging :rocket:

sam: Mock for the badge I had in my head:
```json
{
  "badge": "probable_cause",
  "label": "quota_limit (probable)",
  "confidence": "0.78",
  "reason_code": "Q_LIMIT_APPROACH",
  "evidence_url": "/console/trace/abcd1234"
}
```

alex: also add a small ‘replay’ CTA that runs the decision in a deterministic sim to show what would have happened if fallback hadn’t triggered (useful for canaries).

jen: edgecase: cascading fallbacks — UI should show lineage: which fallback fired first and what downstream decisions were affected. Could be a tiny graph view.

maria: ok action items: (1) badge with confidence + evidence link, (2) audit event spec, (3) replay/simulate button for canary flows, (4) lineage view for cascades. @kevin can you draft the audit event schema? @alex can you sketch the badge microcopy and states?

kevin: quick draft proto below, will formalize in docs.
```proto
message FallbackDecisionEvent {
  string decision_id = 1;
  string route_id = 2;
  string primary_reason = 3; // e.g., Q_LIMIT_APPROACH, MODEL_ERROR, LATENCY_P95
  float confidence = 4;
  repeated string signals = 5; // short codes, e.g., ERR_5XX, QUEUE_HIGH
  string model_version = 6;
  string route_snapshot = 7; // JSON blob ref or S3 path
  int64 timestamp = 8;
}
```

jen: :thumbsup: that looks usable. make sure `route_snapshot` is an immutable pointer.

deploy-bot: incident-bot: recorded event fd-20260301-1234 for decision_id fd-abc-01

alex: tiny UX note: when confidence < 0.6 show ‘investigate’ state instead of definitive label. we should avoid autopromoting a fallback to a single root cause unless we have high signal overlap.

maria: Great. I'll file the tickets and link this thread. thanks everyone — ping me when the proto and microcopy are in a PR.
